latestRelease.updateLog:
v1.0.2

• Fixed world download: worlds now save to /saves/ instead of /resourcepacks/.
• Fixed update dialog: entire dialog is now scrollable so long changelogs are readable.
• Expanded Boat renderers: added GL4ES 1.15, Vulkan-Zink, vGPU, and GlideNuke options.
• Expanded Pojav renderers: added GL4ES 1.15, vGPU, and GlideNuke options.
• Renderer selection centralized in RendererOptions for easier future additions.
